However, he expressed the need to further study the financial implications of these measures on the actuarial life of the GSIS fund.  Rep. Guanlao informed the members that the merits of most amendments were were throughly deliberated during the during the 15th Congress and a consolidated version was approved on 3rd Reading. He moved that HB 249 & 1223 which wre basically the same as what was approved on on 3rd Reading.  The motion was duly seconded and approved.  A TWC was created chaired by Rep. Tinio to consider other measures.  The guests representing teacher groups and government employees express support for both motions.
